commit.author: Azzinoth
commit.message: Updated Focal Engine submodule to the latest version; Project list is now a list of FEProjectInfo entries that is saved in Resources/ProjectList.txt, projects could be added from any folder, previously list was read from one projects folder and every entry was a full FEProject;= FEProject now exists only for the opened project; Projects of the new default Projects folder of the editor are added to the list at every start, folder is in .gitignore; Project list has new interface: grid of cards or list with details panel, filter by name, sorting by last opened time, name or date added, menu on right click and its own popups; Project whose folder is missing now stays in the list greyed with 'Locate folder...' that accepts only folder with project of the same ID; 'Delete project' now moves whole project folder to the Recycle Bin after confirmation, previously it deleted only files of the top folder; Added 'Remove from list', 'Rename' that changes only name in Project.txt and 'Show in Explorer'; Copy of a project from the list now gets new ID when it is added, and thumbnails are loaded with new IDs, previously two copies of a project in the list caused 'New ID is already in use' assertion; 'Save project as...' now gives project new ID and adds new folder to the list; Project.txt now has CreatedWith and SavedWith with version, build number and commit of editor and engine; Removed -set_projects_folder command line action, restarted editor reads saved project list, -load_project now adds project to the list; Folder dropped on the project list is now added to it, previously it became the projects folder; Plugins window without a project is now a centered panel in the style of the project list over dimmed list, previously it covered the whole window; Added FEProjectManager::AddToProjectList, AddProjectsFromFolderToList, RemoveFromProjectList, CanBeRemovedFromProjectList, DeleteProject, RenameProject, LocateProject, GetDefaultProjectsFolder, PushProjectListStyle and PopProjectListStyle; FEProjectManager::GetList is now GetProjectList and returns list of FEProjectInfo; FEProjectManager::OpenProject now takes only project folder and CreateNewProject returns bool; Removed FEProjectManager::OpenProject with index, SetProjectsFolder, GetProjectsFolder, InitializeResources and PROJECTS_FOLDER; FEProjectManager::LoadProjectList now reads the saved list and should be called by the application, list is saved only after that call; Added FEProject::ReadProjectFile, ReadProjectID, SetNameInProjectFile and SetNewIDInProjectFile for Project.txt of a project that is not opened, FEProject::ReadPluginIDs now uses ReadProjectFile; Added FEEditor::GetEditorCommitHash.
